title: Ops signal quadrant & staffing runbook (post-launch readiness)
content:
Purpose: lightweight, operationally-focused sheet to track post-launch KPI pulse, map signal severity to actions, and compute temporary staffing deltas for the first 8 weeks after a launch. Designed for quick handoffs in the War Room and to inform the standby roster for nights/weekends.

How to use: copy this sheet per launch, populate week-0 baseline, set target ranges, then update daily with observed values. If a signal crosses a ‘Quadrant trigger’, follow the Actions/Owners column and escalate as noted.

QUADRANT MODEL (one-line):
- X axis: user-impact (low -> high). Y axis: operational volatility (stable -> spiky).
- Quadrant A (low impact / low volatility): monitor, async owner.
- Quadrant B (high impact / low volatility): immediate product fix, support-level comms.
- Quadrant C (low impact / high volatility): investigate infra patterns, schedule capacity/optimization work.
- Quadrant D (high impact / high volatility): declare incident, full war-room, scale staffing to 2x standby.

SHEET LAYOUT (columns to maintain):
- Week (0..8)
- KPI Name (e.g., 95p latency, request success rate)
- Baseline (pre-launch)
- Target Range (green/yellow/red thresholds)
- Observed (daily snapshot)
- Trend (up / flat / down / spike)
- Signal Quadrant (A/B/C/D)
- Immediate Action (bullet: page, throttle, rollback, patch)
- Primary Owner (name + role)
- Secondary Owner
- Escalation (who to alert at 1st, 2nd threshold)
- Staffing Delta (headcount delta recommended for 24/48/72h)
- Notes / Mitigation Steps

EXAMPLE ROWS (copied into sheet):
- Week 0 | 95p latency | 120ms | <200ms / 200-400ms / >400ms | 430ms | spike | D | "Scale pods, enable degraded mode, page infra-on-call" | "Sam (SRE)" | "Priya (PM)" | "VP Eng -> CEO if >24h" | +3 (24h) / +2 (48h) | "Investigating kernel OOMs, rolling restart planned"
- Week 1 | Error rate (user flows) | 0.4% | <1% / 1-3% / >3% | 2.1% | up | B | "Enable circuit-breaker, route traffic to stable model variant" | "Ava (Prod Eng)" | "Liam (Support)" | "Head of Product if >48h" | +1 (24h) / +1 (48h) | "Config rollback candidate prepared"

STAFFING DELTA HEURISTICS (quick reference):
- Quadrant A: no immediate staffing change; log and triage in regular backlog.
- Quadrant B: bring product owner + 1 engineer for 8h shift; rotate support lead.
- Quadrant C: SRE + infra engineer for 12h probe; consider short-term scaling.
- Quadrant D: escalate to full incident posture; target +100% on-call coverage for first 24h, then re-evaluate.

ROUTINES (daily):
- 09:00 runbook sync (10m): update Week X observed KPIs, mark quadrant assignments.
- 12:00 tactical check-in (if any KPI in yellow/red).
- 18:00 evening triage (owner updates mitigations and staffing for next 24h).

ESCALATION TEMPLATES (copy/paste):
- Page (Ops): "[ALERT] {{kpi}} crossed red in {{launch}} — current {{value}} — quadrant {{Q}} — paging {{owner}}. Immediate action: {{action}}."
- Slack DM to execs: "Brief: lead metric {{kpi}} trending {{trend}} for {{duration}}. Potential user impact: {{estimate}}. Next steps: {{next}}."

OPEN QUESTIONS / DECISIONS NEEDED:
- Who is the default PM for 48h escalations when multiple features are in flight? Proposed: product-ops assigns a rotating PM for the first week.
- SLA communication: at what threshold do we trigger an external status page update? Proposed: >3% outage-equivalent or >24h D quadrant.
- Night/weekend on-call: define minimum standby rota and phone numbers (not included here).

TODO (short):
- [ ] Add links to status page and runbook checklist for each launch (owner: Ethan).
- [ ] Convert this sheet to a template and add to Confluence (owner: Priya).
- [ ] Populate standby roster with timezones for the next 6 launches (owner: Liam).

NOTES TO SELF (working thoughts):
- Consider adding an automated signal importer from telemetry (Datadog/Jager) to populate Observed + Trend columns. Would reduce manual error.
- For experiments with model-variants, include an extra column: Vulnerable Cohort (yes/no) to clarify blast radius.
